description: Knowledge about the natural world, scientific principles, and major fields of science.

topics.name: Scientific Method
knowledge: Science uses observation, experimentation, and evidence to understand reality.
The scientific method includes asking questions, forming hypotheses, testing ideas, and analyzing results.
Scientific knowledge improves as new evidence becomes available.

topics.name: Physics
knowledge: Physics studies matter, energy, forces, and motion.
Forces can change the movement of objects.
Energy can change forms but is conserved in physical systems.
Electricity and magnetism are important areas of physics.

topics.name: Chemistry
knowledge: Chemistry studies substances, their properties, and how they interact.
Atoms are the basic units of matter.
Chemical reactions transform substances into new materials.
Elements are organized in the periodic table.

topics.name: Biology
knowledge: Biology studies living organisms and life processes.
Cells are the basic units of life.
DNA contains genetic information.
Living systems interact with their environments.

topics.name: Earth and Space Science
knowledge: Earth science studies the planet, climate, oceans, and geology.
Astronomy studies stars, planets, galaxies, and the universe.
Space exploration uses science and engineering to study beyond Earth.

topics.name: Technology and Innovation
knowledge: Scientific discoveries often lead to new technologies.
Engineering applies scientific knowledge to solve practical problems.
Innovation combines ideas, research, and creativity to create improvements.
